candidate_relations.scope_detail: Erdheim-Chester Disease (ECD) is a distinct non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis with different clinical and histological features.

candidate_relations.reason: Gaucher disease is characterized by accumulation of glucocerebroside in macrophages, leading to hepatosplenomegaly, bone disease, and neurological symptoms. candidate_relations.scope_detail: Gaucher disease is a lysosomal storage disorder with different clinical and pathological features.
